summary_out.hypothesis: PARTIALLY REJECTED. The 'g1l1 was over-cutting at q=0.75' branch is rejected — relaxing to q=0.80 did not recover EV-positive trades net of their adverse-selection cost (-1.96% pnl despite +0.34% trade_count). The complementary branch — 'q=0.75 was at or past the EV peak' — is the surviving hypothesis. Mechanism: the [p75, p80] spread band carries enough adverse-selection premium that re-admitting those entries costs slightly more than they earn on the 30s horizon. The peak is on a plateau, not a sharp summit (loss is small, monotonic with cut depth in this neighborhood). Confirms: island-0's edge ceiling is the two-axis composition at q≈0.75; spread-quantile alone cannot push above g1l1.
